' "$V"; printf '%s
' "$D"; printf '%s
' "$V" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$D" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; echo silent_audio_guard_pre_call=true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; ACTIVE=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(state); echo live_call_state=$ST; [ "$ST" = "2" ] && ACTIVE=1 && break; sleep 0.4; done; test "$ACTIVE" = "1"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8; V=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -A6 -B1 'STREAM_VOICE_CALL' | head -n 10); D=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | grep -i -A6 -B1 'STREAM_DTMF' | head -n 10); printf '%s
' "$V" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$D" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; echo silent_audio_guard_active=true; sleep 2; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe capture-live 1500"); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'probe=downlink-pipe-v3'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'audio_mode=2'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'session_started=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'route_guard=telephony_confirmed_by_session_start'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'bytes_read=48000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'samples_read=24000'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'half_sample_carry=false'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'terminated_after_reader_close=true'; printf '%s
' "$OUT" | grep -q 'terminal_failure_present=false'; NZ=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | sed -n 's/^non_zero_samples=//p' | tail -n1); test -n "$NZ"; test "$NZ" -gt 0; echo downlink_nonzero_samples=$NZ; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; sleep 1; test "$(state)" = "0"; trap - EXIT; echo phase2_downlink_live_silent_ok=true
